name: frozen-worker
notes: The worker is already in state T at the first usable sample: PROCESS_STOPPED carries onset_unknown, and no start time is invented.
No causal rule links an observed stop to downstream effects without progress or CPU telemetry, so the graph stays empty and the cause is UNKNOWN.

Re-audit 2026-10-28 (principal, causal-semantics.md §5.2 clarified): a failure is never its own candidate, and an escalation-only path is the anchor's own episode (known chain), not a contributing factor. Suspected-kill/write-failure alternatives explain exit failures only, never a condition anchor.

missing_evidence_includes: stop-sender telemetry (who sent SIGSTOP/ptrace) is not captured in v1 bundles
